author: Cerebrum Team
description: real: MEP review discipline ported from <private-repo> app/review.py (approve/reject/edit rules), app/review_package.py (verification_of / enrich_change_set / annotate_bcf) and app/monitors/base.py (three-valued monitor contract). Approve refuses while unacknowledged unprovable checks remain; reject reopens eligible clashes; edit maps a re-monitored verdict to verified/verified_conditional/escalated. In-process ledger; monitor implementations are the caller's.
